name: Midnight Prayer
source:
After being solicited for an urgency, an exorcist named Venerius goes to a little church. There, he meets the nuns that are in charge of the church, now that the bishop is possessed by a demon.

Will you be able to save him with the help of the Sisters?

[From [url=https://joysthicc.itch.io/midnight-prayer]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在接到紧急请求后，一位名叫维内里乌斯的驱魔师去了一座小教堂。在那里，他遇到了负责教堂的修女们，因为主教被恶魔附身了。

你能在姐妹们的帮助下拯救他吗？

[来自[url=https://joysthicc.itch.io/midnight-prayer]itch.io[/url]]
